label: Autumn Glow - DACH
teaches: The canonical run. One hero reused, one generated. The console opens on the exercise's minimum - 1:1, 9:16, 16:9 in one market - for 6 creatives from 1 model call; select every format and market and the SAME single call yields 24.

label: Radiance - global launch
teaches: The shape the exercise describes: three products across five markets and four formats. 60 creatives from 2 generations, because one product already has an approved hero and markets multiply output at zero additional model cost.

label: Nordvik - cold start
teaches: A different brand launching from nothing. No approved assets at all, so both heroes are generated from text.

label: Restock - UK
teaches: The smallest valid brief, and the cheapest run. Both heroes already approved, so nothing is generated.

label: Rejected copy
teaches: A brief carrying prohibited claims. Preflight stops it before a single credit is spent.

label: Incomplete brief
teaches: A brief that does not satisfy the contract at all: required fields missing, and two entries for the same product. Refused before preflight, with an error written for the marketer rather than a dump of validation objects.
